bio: In this lively, welcoming restaurant close to the theatre, guests will be tempted by delicious dishes (such as oxtail parmentier – something of a speciality here), a menu of market-inspired specials (on this particular day, a delicious cep fondant as a starter), classic and rather fine flavours. In short, Au Chat Noir is the type of bistro you'd be happy to come across more often. Be sure to book!...
